note: Canonical variant registry for BariSign. URLs are ALWAYS resolved at runtime; nothing here pins a version. Used by the a-Shell scripts in bin/ and poc/.

resolution.stable: newest release where prerelease == false AND the tag matches no alpha/beta/rc (case-insensitive). Do NOT use /releases/latest for SideStore: it currently returns 0.7.0-alpha.
resolution.nightly: the release whose tag is exactly 'nightly' (a rolling release; its assets are replaced in place, so show the asset's updated_at, not the release's published_at)
resolution.asset: the first asset whose name matches asset_pattern, ending in .ipa. Match by pattern, never by a fixed versioned filename: AltStore embeds the version in the asset name.
resolution.version_to_show: for nightly use the asset updated_at date; for stable use the tag

warnings.nightly: Nightly builds are pre-release and may be unstable.
warnings.free_account: A free Apple ID can have 3 apps installed at a time (SideStore counts as one) and signing expires every 7 days.

variants.notes: Minimum iOS 17.4. v2.3 (2026-09-30) added computer-free sideloading through a 'Remote AltServer' setup step and credits the SideStore team; the exact mechanism is unverified by us. AltStore PAL is EU-only and is not an installable IPA, so it is out of scope.
variants.no_nightly_reason: altstoreio/AltStore has exactly ONE release; older tags exist but carry no release and no assets, so there is no installable nightly/beta IPA.
